column1: # Forever item sets: the new and changed item sets of spec jvbastel/WOWAI#225 (#231). forever/generator writes
# them into ItemSet.dbc of the Forever DBC folder (the core reads the set bonuses there with Forever.Rules = 1)
# and of the client data patch (the tooltip), and the set ID into the forever_item_template row of each piece
# that is an item row of items.tsv. A stock piece keeps its stock row and can only be in its own stock set.
# Never edit a generated file by hand. To gather the data again, see forever/REFRESH.md.
# Source: WoW Forever build 1.60.1.70685, recorded 2026-10-30: the local Forever client (ItemSet and
# ItemSetSpell, item sets 1968 and 321), compared with the stock 1.12 ItemSet.dbc. Only numbers and names.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   kind         set: a new item set (the set ID keeps the Forever ID, which is no stock set ID)
#                stockset: a changed stock item set (the stock set ID)
#                bonus: one set bonus of the set `set`
#   set          the ItemSet.dbc ID
#   name         the set name (set row); a label (bonus row)
#   threshold    bonus: the number of worn pieces that gives the bonus; set, stockset: -
#   pieces       set, stockset: the item entries, in tooltip order (at most 17); bonus: -
#   bonuses      bonus: "<bonus> <value>" or "<bonus> <rounded> (Forever <value>)", separated by commas, as in
#                items.tsv (equip_stats.py), plus Strength, ShadowRes and HealthRegen (item_sets.py); each is a
#                stock 1.12 equip spell. "none": a Forever bonus with no 1.12 aura, not ported. set, stockset: -
#   foreverSpell bonus: the Forever set spell (ItemSetSpell); set, stockset: -
#   notes        free text
